icon.safeMargin: Keep the full quadcopter and both outer LED paths inside the platform mask-safe area; do not crop the upper or lower arm segments.

visualBasis.sourceFrame: simulator frame 60 at 30 FPS, captured from the built-in simulator
behavior: the 40 logical LEDs are mirrored onto 80 physical positions
the lit nodes occupy only the left and right outer arm paths
the sampled frame progresses from brighter cyan at the upper segment to deeper blue along the lower segment
the center body, propellers, and inner guard rings remain unlit
visualBasis.iconColorTreatment: ice-blue/cyan upper path, violet transition, restrained ember orange lower path

icon.style: 2D raster technical illustration with enclosing outer LED paths
icon.basis: previous 2D icon plus simulator frame geometry and hardware-profile topology
